constraints.summary: Maintain one short agent entrypoint for the repo.
constraints.verification_hint: AGENTS.md exists and points to deeper docs instead of duplicating them.
constraints.rationale: 未扫描到现有 agent 入口；Harness 需要生成一个清晰的入口草稿。

constraints.summary: Keep detailed guidance in docs/harness instead of one large instruction blob.
constraints.verification_hint: Detailed rules live below docs/harness and the entrypoint stays short.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Define module, subsystem, and dependency boundaries explicitly.
constraints.verification_hint: Architecture constraints name the repo-specific subsystem boundaries.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Centralize shared interfaces, schemas, or boundary contracts.
constraints.verification_hint: Shared contracts have an owner and an expected validation path.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Prevent files and functions from growing beyond reviewable size.
constraints.verification_hint: Adoption can start as review guidance and later become a lint gate.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Define the minimum checks before work is accepted.
constraints.verification_hint: Required gates only contain high-confidence commands or explicitly confirmed commands.
constraints.rationale: 未扫描到可靠命令，因此 gate 需要保留为待确认。

constraints.summary: Keep agent entrypoints and Harness docs synced with the repo.
constraints.verification_hint: Harness docs mention the current toolchain and known entrypoints.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: State what agents may edit, run, or only propose.
constraints.verification_hint: The operating model defines write, execution, network, and deployment boundaries.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Prevent new work from increasing structural entropy.
constraints.verification_hint: Legacy or mixed repos define which areas are ratcheted first.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Explain how proposed work is accepted, rejected, or escalated.
constraints.verification_hint: The Harness states the reviewer model and what evidence is required.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Separate drivers, BSP, and application logic.
constraints.verification_hint: Driver and application ownership boundaries are explicit.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Isolate board and MCU specifics from reusable logic.
constraints.verification_hint: Board-specific code has a named location and cannot leak into shared logic.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Define what is validated in CI versus on hardware.
constraints.verification_hint: Hardware-only validation is clearly separated from CI gates.
constraints.rationale: 嵌入式证据要求区分 CI 可验证内容和硬件实测置信度。

constraints.summary: Document build, flash, debug, and recovery entrypoints.
constraints.verification_hint: Unknown flash/debug commands remain placeholders until confirmed.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: State manual validation expectations when automation is limited.
constraints.verification_hint: Manual checks include owner, environment, and pass/fail evidence.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Each file and module owns one concern; sibling files share the same purpose.
constraints.verification_hint: Architecture doc lists each module's single responsibility and rejects mixed concerns.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Forbid back-references and circular imports between modules.
constraints.verification_hint: A circular-dependency check command is named (or marked placeholder) and runs in CI when adopted.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Declare layer order (e.g. UI -> service -> repo -> infra); lower layers must not import higher layers.
constraints.verification_hint: Architecture doc shows a layered dependency diagram and forbidden directions.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Each module exposes a single public entrypoint (e.g. index.ts, __init__.py); internals are not imported across modules.
constraints.verification_hint: The Harness names each module's public entrypoint and forbids deep imports across module boundaries.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Shared interfaces and schemas have an owner, change process, and breaking-change protocol.
constraints.verification_hint: Each shared contract lists owner, location, and how breaking changes are introduced.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Define explicit unit/integration/e2e layers with minimum scope and command per layer.
constraints.verification_hint: Testing doc lists each layer, what it covers, its command, and confidence.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Tests must not depend on real network, real credentials, or production data; external boundaries are mocked or sandboxed.
constraints.verification_hint: Test environment doc names every external boundary and how it is mocked or sandboxed.
constraints.rationale: 项目评估显示该约束适用于当前仓库形态。

constraints.summary: Before material feature work, use a Grill protocol to align the invisible shared design concept (branches, deps, failure modes); output lands in PRD/task/issue.
constraints.verification_hint: grill-protocol.md documents trigger, owner, question list, output path, and done-definition; work is traceable to that artifact.
constraints.rationale: AI 辅助开发需先沉淀共享设计概念，避免仅改规格再生成的 vibe loop。

constraints.summary: Domain terms live in docs/harness/glossary.md; requirements, code names, and discussions use the same vocabulary.
constraints.verification_hint: Glossary lists term, definition, owner, and forbidden synonyms; changes flow glossary-first then code/docs.
constraints.rationale: 人与模型、业务与代码需共享同一套领域词汇表。

constraints.summary: For agreed target dirs: write tests first, make implementation pass, then refactor (TDD-style) to shorten the AI feedback loop.
constraints.verification_hint: testing-and-gates.md lists test_first_targets; PRs touching those paths show test-before-implementation or escalation note.
constraints.rationale: 测试先行缩短反馈回路，约束模型不超越当前可验证范围。

constraints.summary: Prefer deep modules: simple public surface, complexity inside; avoid shallow maze of tiny files and wrappers with complex call graphs.
constraints.verification_hint: architecture-constraints.md states frozen public surfaces per module and forbids shallow-wrapper-only splits.
constraints.rationale: 对外保持简单曲面，复杂度收于模块内部，避免浅模块迷宫。

constraints.summary: Humans own strategy: architecture, boundaries, ubiquitous language, test pyramid; AI acts tactically inside frozen interfaces and tests.
constraints.verification_hint: operating-model.md lists strategic_human_gates vs tactical AI tasks; no new cross-module contracts without human sign-off.
constraints.rationale: 战略（架构/边界/语言/金字塔）须人签字；AI 只在冻结契约下战术实现。
